title: Half of all Sudanese children not in education due to civil war
summary: In tonight's edition, an unspoken crisis emerges in Sudan, as the country faces one of the world's longest school closures. Also, South Africa’s iconic Kruger National Park reels from devastating floods, with damage of over $30 million, and 15 camps shut.
